pairs.title: Less boxy, more open
pairs.listen_for: The boxy build-up in the low mids clears, and the words sound more open. Setting: low cut at 80 Hz, −4 dB at 400 Hz.

pairs.title: More presence
pairs.listen_for: The voice steps forward and the words get easier to follow, without getting louder. Setting: +4 dB at 3 kHz, wide.

pairs.title: More air
pairs.listen_for: Breath and shine above the voice open up, while its body stays the same. Setting: high shelf, +5 dB from 8 kHz.
